title: Voice: hands-free keywords over a playing reply — pause, continue, faster, slower, stop

personas.persona: The owner, out walking the dog with earbuds in. Talks casually, a bit impatient, says 'okay' a lot.
goals: Get main to explain out loud how a hash map handles collisions — a proper explanation of about thirty seconds of speech, not a one-liner.
While main is explaining, drive the speech with your voice: pause it, let it continue, make it faster, then slower again, and finally stop it before the end.
Then ask one short follow-up question about what you heard and let main answer it to the end.
script: First turn: ask for the explanation and say you want it properly, about thirty seconds. Plan during_reply exactly: [{"at_s":3,"text":"pause"},{"at_s":6,"text":"continue"},{"at_s":9,"text":"faster"},{"at_s":13,"text":"slower"},{"at_s":17,"text":"stop"}]
Second turn: one short follow-up about what you heard (no during_reply).

voice_checks.name: no voice command reached MAIN as a message
the stopped reply did not play to the end
the box heard the person (mean box WER <= 0.15)
